name: Avatar
summary: Compose a native-backed avatar image with an arbitrary fallback indicator.

useWhen: Showing a compact person or workspace image with fallback content.
avoidWhen: Managing identity data, image processing, or stacked avatar collections.

obligations: Avatar.Image requires an alt string; use a meaningful value for informative media and alt="" for decorative media.
Avatar.Fallback accepts arbitrary children and is visible when no image is supplied, while the image loads, or when the image fails.
While an informative image loads or after it fails, retain its alt text as the avatar name without exposing image and fallback names simultaneously.

behavior: Root, Image, and Fallback are Mux-owned compound parts backed by native span and img hosts; they are not React Aria primitives.
Place Image and Fallback directly under Root or inside a React.Fragment; opaque wrapper components are rejected so image and fallback state cannot diverge.

Arbitrary fallback children stay visible while the image loads and after it fails; the image is stacked above them and covers them as soon as it decodes, including before hydration, and a source or source-set change returns to the loading fallback. Without JavaScript a failed image may show the browser's broken-image indicator.

No loading animation is introduced; server markup shows the fallback, unavailable sources use the fallback path, cached native success is reported as loaded, and hydration reconciles native state without replaying callbacks.
accessibility: Informative image alt text names the native image once it loads and names the avatar root while it loads, when its source is unavailable, or when it fails.
Decorative alt="" images and their fallback remain out of the accessibility tree unless the caller supplies an explicit root name.
Caller-supplied refs, ARIA attributes, data attributes, and native image callbacks are preserved.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
